comparison.objective: Hang a bottle mouth-down on a drying peg; candidate tunes and locks a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Bottle inversion, peg-mouth alignment, insertion, and hands-free release versus hex-key/collar manipulation and dynamic feedback control.
comparison.success_condition: Peg at least 3 cm inside and bottle hanging stably versus two acceptable impact stops. Candidate lacks fixed rebound/overload/drift thresholds.
comparison.reason: Peg insertion and hanging stability test a different ability.
